scope: Reached recursive array and declared-property Stringable/string comparisons; native original file/CWD/START and observed tuple retained. Materialized-property caster and Fiber VM transfer remain explicit dependencies.

cases.source:
<?php
class NestedOrderCast {
    public function __toString(): string { echo "C"; return "007"; }
}
$cast = new NestedOrderCast;
echo "count|", [$cast] == [] ? "BAD" : "N";
echo "|key|", ["left" => $cast] == ["right" => "7"] ? "BAD" : "N";
echo "|early|", [0, $cast] == [1, "7"] ? "BAD" : "N";
echo "|nested|", ["k" => [$cast, 9]] == ["k" => ["7", 9]] ? "Y" : "N";
echo "|reverse|", ["k" => ["7", 9]] == ["k" => [$cast, 9]] ? "Y" : "N";
echo "|strict|", [$cast] === ["007"] ? "BAD" : "N";
echo "|switch|";
switch ([$cast]) {
    case ["7"]: echo "S"; break;
    default: echo "BAD";
}

<?php
class NestedArrayCast {
    public function __toString(): string {
        global $right;
        $right[0] = "after";
        $right[1] = "new";
        echo "C";
        return "after";
    }
}
$cast = new NestedArrayCast;
$right = ["before", "old"];
echo "value|", [$cast, "new"] == $right ? "Y" : "N";
echo ":", $right[0], ":", $right[1], "|";
$leaf = "before"; $tail = "old";
$right = [&$leaf, &$tail];
echo "reference|", [$cast, "new"] == $right ? "Y" : "N";
echo ":", $leaf, ":", $tail;

<?php
class NestedPropertyPair {
    public $leaf;
    public $tail = "old";
    public $replacement = "after";
}
class NestedPropertyCast {
    public function __toString(): string {
        global $right;
        $right->leaf =& $right->replacement;
        $right->tail = "new";
        echo "C";
        return "after";
    }
}
$cast = new NestedPropertyCast;
$left = new NestedPropertyPair; $left->leaf = $cast; $left->tail = "new";
$right = new NestedPropertyPair; $right->leaf = "before";
echo "slot|", $left == $right ? "Y" : "N";
echo ":", $right->leaf, ":", $right->tail, "|";
$right = new NestedPropertyPair; $right->leaf = "before";
$retained =& $right->leaf;
echo "cell|", $left == $right ? "Y" : "N";
echo ":", $retained, ":", $right->leaf, ":", $right->tail;

<?php
class PeerCompareBox {
    public $first;
    public $later;
}
class PeerPropertyThrow {
    public function __toString(): string {
        echo 'cast|';
        switch ('inner') {
            default: echo 'bad-inner|'; break;
            case 'inner': echo 'inner|'; break;
        }
        throw new TypeError('property-case');
    }
}
class PeerLaterProperty {
    public function __toString(): string {
        echo 'late-property|';
        return 'unused';
    }
}
$left = new PeerCompareBox;
$right = new PeerCompareBox;
$left->first = new PeerPropertyThrow;
$right->first = 'hit';
$left->later = 'unused';
$right->later = new PeerLaterProperty;
function peerLaterBox() {
    global $right;
    echo 'late-case|';
    return $right;
}
try {
    switch ($left) {
        default: echo 'bad-default|'; break;
        case $right: echo 'bad-match|'; break;
        case peerLaterBox(): echo 'bad-later|';
    }
} catch (Throwable $caught) {
    echo $caught::class, '|', $caught->getMessage(), '|';
} finally {
    echo 'finally|';
}
echo 'done';

<?php
class PeerRecursiveBox {
    public $value;
}
class PeerPropertyReenter {
    public function __toString(): string {
        global $left, $right;
        echo 'cast|';
        try {
            $nested = $left == $right;
            echo $nested ? 'bad-true|' : 'bad-false|';
        } catch (Error $caught) {
            echo $caught->getMessage(), '|';
        }
        return '7';
    }
}
$left = new PeerRecursiveBox;
$right = new PeerRecursiveBox;
$left->value = new PeerPropertyReenter;
$right->value = '007';
switch ($left) {
    default: echo 'bad-default|'; break;
    case $right: echo 'matched|'; break;
}
echo 'done';

<?php
class RestartNestedCast {
    public $text;
    public function __toString(): string {
        echo $this->text, "|";
        return $this->text;
    }
}
$first = new RestartNestedCast; $first->text = "007";
$second = new RestartNestedCast; $second->text = "tail";
switch ([$first, ["k" => $second]]) {
    default: echo "bad-default"; break;
    case ["7", ["k" => "tail"]]: echo "selected"; break;
}
